nodes.label: Per-photo number plate redaction editor
Manual-first: Trax found zero plates on the eight real photos measured, so drag-a-box is the main path
Opaque black rectangle, not blur or pixelate — CSS blur/low-radius pixelate can be reversed enough to read a plate
Image decoded exactly once and regions stored as 0-1 ratios so the box drawn and the box filled cannot drift apart
6% per-edge region padding buys back plates whose last character was clipped by a hurried box
Export canvas capped at ~16.7M px because iOS Safari silently returns a blank canvas above it
JPEG quality ladder down to 0.5 to keep the body under the 5MB an edge function will accept
Never crossOrigin on an img — a tainted canvas throws on toBlob and kills the feature at the last step; fetch to Blob instead
imageOrientation from-image, or a phone photo's EXIF rotation paints the plate sideways from where the box was drawn
Scale down rather than fail: a scaled export is still a redacted photo whereas a blank one is a leak
Floor the fill origin and ceil the size so pixel rounding can only ever cover more of the plate
Canvas export and server save must not share a catch — the canvas half has no toast, so a shared catch leaves a dialog that looks like it worked
Only abandon a drag when the pointer really escaped — plates sit at the frame edge and cancelling there makes the box undrawable
touchAction none on the canvas, otherwise a drag on a phone scrolls the dialog instead of drawing a box
View mode shows the customer-facing redacted file, edit mode draws on the original
Three-state redaction outcome: redacted, no_plate, or untouched
Vehicle photo gallery: multi-upload, drag reorder, delete, banner selection
Redact control gated on tenant.hide_vehicle_registration AND a role the edge function accepts
Client role list mirrors save-photo-redaction's ACL so ops/viewer are never shown a button that 403s after they did the work
Redact button is always visible and bottom-right: hover-only drew 'there is no option to blur the plate', and bottom-left collided with the drag handle
Staff always render photo_url (the original); redacted_url is only what the booking site serves customers
Redaction columns are declared on the local type even though select('*') returns them, so a rename cannot silently disable the controls
display_order 0 is the banner photo shown on the booking site
At least one photo must remain — delete is suppressed on the last photo
Failed DB insert removes the just-uploaded storage object to avoid orphaned files
Photo mutations invalidate the vehicle-photos, vehicle and vehicles query keys together
Turo-style per-day price override calendar for one vehicle
A per-day custom price overrides the base rate AND every weekend/holiday surcharge for that day
Set / increase / decrease bulk price adjustment across a day selection
Per-vehicle overrides of tenant weekend and holiday surcharge rules
Effective rate precedence: global holiday exclusion, then vehicle override (excluded / fixed_price / custom_percent), then the inherited surcharge
Holiday dates split manually rather than passed through new Date(), avoiding the date-only UTC shift
Per-vehicle rental extras: assign, price, create and remove
Two extras pricing modes: global extras apply to all vehicles read-only, per_vehicle extras carry a vehicle-specific price row
Creating an extra through the rental-extras hook needs a manual vehicle-extras cache invalidation because the two hooks own different query keys
Removing a per-vehicle extra price makes the extra disappear for that vehicle on the booking site
Third-party vehicle owner assignment with per-vehicle commission override
Commission resolution: vehicle-level override wins, else inherit the owner's default rate; 'Own fleet' means no owner
Clearing the owner nulls every override field, so a vehicle returned to own-fleet cannot keep a stale commission
Vehicle disposal recording with book cost and P&L gain/loss
Two-step confirm gate before an admin-only-reversible P&L posting
Live gain/loss preview = sale proceeds minus computed book cost
Destructive vehicle actions log both the warning being shown and the resulting status change
Undo vehicle disposal: restore Available status and delete the P&L gain/loss entries
Vehicle inspection and registration compliance status panel with reminder rollup
Four-state due vocabulary shared with the reminder engine: ok, due_soon, overdue, missing
UK-named columns mot_due_date / tax_due_date are surfaced as US 'Inspection' and 'Registration' — the DB was never renamed
Backward-compat shim: MOTTaxStatusChip forwards to InspectionRegistrationStatusChip, mapping MOT/TAX to Inspection/Registration
Vehicle maintenance/service history with cost tracking
A service record with cost > 0 posts a P&L entry, and deleting the record removes it again
Service plan presence indicator for a vehicle
Spare key custody indicator: company vs customer, with holder notes
Vehicle net profit/loss chip with revenue and cost breakdown tooltip
Vehicle lifecycle status vocabulary: available, rented, maintenance, disposed
Vehicle document library: drag-drop upload, download and delete
canUpload/canDelete default to true 'until auth is implemented' — the document library is effectively ungated by RBAC
Client-side duplicate guard by file_name plus a 25MB / office-document MIME allowlist
Legacy single hero-photo upload/replace/remove for a vehicle
Reg-watermarked car-silhouette placeholder for missing or broken vehicle photos
Physical licence-plate order tracking per vehicle (ordered / received / fitted)
Plate cost is hard-coded to a '$' prefix while every sibling panel formats with the tenant currency
Tenant-currency metric card/item primitive with trend direction
Currency fallback drift: MetricItem falls back to GBP while every other vehicle panel falls back to USD
Tenant currency convention: tenant?.currency_code with a hard-coded fallback in every vehicle panel
Vehicle detail page tab surface these panels compose into
vehicle_photos table
vehicles table
plates table
vehicle-photos storage bucket
save-photo-redaction edge function
detect-plate-regions edge function (Trax plate detection)
Booking site photo serving — the consumer of redacted_url
Vehicle P&L ledger fed by service costs and disposal gain/loss
calculate-rental-price: the consumer that must reconcile base rate, surcharges and per-day overrides
